title: Proof Plan for Depth Preservation
body_html:
Proof Plan for Depth Preservation

  1. Express fixed-vector spaces in any oscillator model as support subspaces \(S_L\).
  2. Prove the one-step descent lemma: fixed vectors supported at level \(j/(2m)\) are contained in a sum of supports at level \((j+1)/(2m)\).
  3. Iterate the descent from \(j>k\) down to \(k\) for \(r=k/m\).
  4. Sum over all target building points with denominator \(2m\), obtaining the formula for \(S^{G_{x,r+}}\).
  5. Apply an oscillator quotient map to a nonzero theta lift. A source vector fixed by \(G_{x,r+}\) maps into some target support \(S_{B_{x,y,r/2}}\), giving target depth at most source depth.
  6. Reverse the dual-pair roles to get equality of depths.
